diagnosis: The tax report polling endpoint retrieves asynchronous generation results from an in-memory JOB_REGISTRY dictionary by job_id. It fails to check if job["user_id"] == current_user.id, allowing any authenticated user to poll job IDs and extract generated financial summaries and W-2 filings belonging to other users.
exploit_request:
GET /reports/queue-jobs/job_tax_2025_98124 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.taxcloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
